verdict.summary: Pass for 8/10 progression. All 8 unique Notes captures score >= 8.0 (mean 8.1) and all 4 Settings captures score >= 8.3 (mean 8.4). All three council reviewers (Argon 8.1, Opus 8.1, Sol 8.2 Notes; 8.4 Settings across all three) independently clear the 8.0 gate.

verified_findings.detail: .workspace > .sidebar .nav-item[aria-current='page'] { box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--accent); } was placed inside @media (max-width: 800px), so desktop Project Atlas has boxShadow: none while mobile Project Atlas and .note-item.selected have the 3px orange rail.

verified_findings.status: confirmed in live DOM and CSS (styles.css:464)
verified_findings.detail: input/select/textarea now use --ky-field-border (4.54:1 light / 5.32:1 dark), but .secondary buttons (Save, + New page) still use var(--line-strong) (2.30:1 light / 2.32:1 dark).
.editor-actions (y=766..887) wraps its 4 controls onto two rows on 390x844 mobile, clipping the bottom half of row 2 (Outdent page, Delete at y=831..871) at the 844px viewport edge.
.recovery-notice summary uses default list-item filled triangle (▸) alongside custom stroked ChevronIcons on mobile disclosures.

keyboard.evidence: Stage-04 ui-council.e2e.ts verifies keyboard expand/collapse of <details class='recovery-notice'> via summary.focus() + keyboard.press('Enter'), focus preservation across saves, and keyboard accessibility.

focus.evidence: 2px solid var(--accent) focus-visible outlines across buttons, inputs, selects and .recovery-notice summary:focus-visible (styles.css:477).

contrast.status: pass on text and form fields; P2 follow-up on .secondary button border and light .avatar chip
contrast.evidence: All form inputs/selects/textareas use --ky-field-border (#72797a = 4.54:1 light, #879191 = 5.32:1 dark). .secondary button border uses --line-strong (2.30:1 light / 2.32:1 dark) and light .avatar background equals sidebar (#f2efe7).

states.evidence: Populated editor, expanded mobile disclosures, collapsed recovery notice and populated theme catalog inspected; empty/error/loading states not in capture set.

responsive.evidence: 04-after-manifest.json confirms horizontalOverflowPx = 0 across all 16 captures at 1280x900 and 390x844; mobile page chooser now shows all 4 pages above the fold (y=354..660).

non_blocking: [P2] Light .avatar chip invisibility: .avatar background var(--panel-hover) (#f2efe7) matches --sidebar-start (#f2efe7) in Busnes Light (styles.css:474); use var(--panel) with 1px border or --ky-field-border ring.

[P2] Desktop selected notebook rail: move .workspace > .sidebar .nav-item[aria-current='page'] { box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--accent); } out of @media (max-width: 800px) (styles.css:497) so desktop matches mobile and .note-item.selected.
[P2] Secondary button border contrast: switch .secondary border (styles.css:464) from var(--line-strong) (2.30:1) to var(--ky-field-border) (4.54:1 light / 5.32:1 dark).
[P3] Desktop list column hierarchy & search width: step down h2.workspace-title from 24px to 17px (--ky-text-section) and set .list-actions .note-search to flex: 1 on desktop (styles.css:93, 189).

[P3] Mobile footer wrap & Settings nav alignment: compact .editor-actions on 390px mobile so row 2 is not clipped at y=844, align mobile .settings-nav left text edge to 16px, and replace the UA <details> triangle on .recovery-notice with ChevronIcon.
path_to_8: Met (Notes 8.1, Settings 8.4, zero views below 8.0 across all three council reviewers). Resolving the P2/P3 items above is the path from 8.1 toward 9.0.
